mintAuthority.summary: MXNe is issued by Brale across Base (BraleToken ERC1967 proxy), Solana (SPL mint), and Stellar (issuer account); on each chain a single issuer-controlled EOA/keypair holds all mint and admin rights.

controls.label: Brale MINTER_ROLE EOA — Base
controls.evidence: At Base block 52024140, hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0xb180f98037a63a3dca66b6b4ddbf250265b65110) and hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, same address) on 0x269cae7dc59803e5c596c95756faeebb6030e0af both returned true. eth_getCode on the controller returned 0x. The ERC1967 implementation remained 0x2a6c613bd6288b1f7e1c02393f1cf92444eadee5.

controls.label: Brale mint authority keypair — Solana
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 452230655, one getMultipleAccounts response confirmed that SPL mint 6zYgzrT7X2wi9a9NeMtUvUWLLmf2a8vBsbYkocYdB9wa has 9 decimals and mintAuthority and freezeAuthority both 3mdd4X7wJjWmhF99jfTNGmSr39EXSAXcdEiS47GejduH. The same atomic response confirmed that authority account is System Program owned, non-executable, and has zero data length.

controls.label: Brale issuer account — Stellar
controls.evidence: Stellar Horizon account snapshot fetched 2026-10-01: issuer GCQCNWT22JDLENQAVIE6DRJGHWAQ6EX2H5ABGPV55EJUPPZM5UA7KHZR has one signer (self, weight 1), all thresholds zero, auth_revocable true and auth_clawback_enabled true. The response records last_modified_ledger 64710391; that is the last account modification, not a pinned current query ledger.

review.evidence: At Base block 47200644: BraleToken proxy 0x269cae7dc59803e5c596c95756faeebb6030e0af (ERC1967 → impl 0x2a6c613bd6288b1f7e1c02393f1cf92444eadee5, source BraleToken confirmed on Blockscout). MINTER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE both held by EOA 0xb180f98037a63a3dca66b6b4ddbf250265b65110. Solana: mintAuthority and freezeAuthority = keypair 3mdd4X7wJjWmhF99jfTNGmSr39EXSAXcdEiS47GejduH (Solana System Program owner = regular keypair). Stellar: issuer GCQCNWT…KHZR is a single-key account. All three chains show Brale-controlled single-EOA/keypair issuer model consistent with documented permissioned mint/redeem. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): BHR Mexico performs recurring independent reasonable-assurance examinations for Etherfuse MX, S.A. de C.V.; the current primary latest endpoint returns the report dated 2026-06-26, reconciling token commitments to bank and investment assets. FinCEN and state transmitter records match Brale Inc., but those are AML/payments permissions rather than prudential stablecoin-issuer supervision. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled direct mint or immediate minter-administration paths are economically unbounded; existing whole-supply periodic reconciliation and independent attestation evidence remain supported.
